value.name: 28' · Shlomi Edri v Maccabi Petah Tikva
value.narrative: Stanislav Dobrovin: heads a long goal kick back into the path of a teammate. Shlomi Edri: hits it first time from around 15 metres into the far corner.

sequence.position: around the box, receiving a long goal kick
sequence.note: Knocks the goal kick down/back with his head for Edri.
Volleys into the far corner past Sagi Strauss.

value.reconstructionScope: Final documented contacts; not the entire possession.

Reconstructions may begin with the final contiguous two to five contacts; omitted upstream contacts are outside the replay scope.

goals.notes: Away derby (Maccabi listed as home). Match date 21 Sep 2002 per RSSSF round 2; Walla piece dated 24.9.2002 confirms Saturday play. Sources differ on who took the later penalty, which does not affect this goal. Walla adds the goal kick came from keeper Eyal Avramov; not included as a touch.

value.name: 59' · Mamady Diarra v Maccabi Haifa
value.narrative: Clé: seizes on a loose Haifa pass and slips a through ball into the counter. Mamady Diarra: carries it into the box and beats goalkeeper Yermakov.

sequence.position: on the counter after a Haifa giveaway
sequence.note: Plays a clever ball in behind after Issat's careless pass is cut out.
Drives on into the penalty area.
Finishes past Yermakov for his first goal in Israel.
